summary: @avigilon/node-webrtc preinstall exfiltrates host identity to burp.attack.live
details: The package's preinstall script in index.js imports os, dns, https, and querystring, then collects hostname (os.hostname()), username (os.userInfo().username), home directory (os.homedir()), DNS server list (dns.getServers()), the package install path (__dirname), and the contents of package.json, and POSTs the aggregated payload over HTTPS to the hardcoded subdomain mj9ouelpgm0d26s3wp0syow03r9ix8lx.burp.attack.live. The @avigilon scope on npm is not an official Avigilon publisher namespace and the payload/beacon shape is consistent with a dependency-confusion / namespace-squat probe targeting internal @avigilon consumers. The exfiltration runs automatically on npm install via scripts.preinstall.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
